I’ve put nearly 1,000 hours into FC25, so I feel qualified to share my thoughts. The game has its moments, but also some major flaws that hold it back.

The core football gameplay is there, and when the mechanics work, it’s genuinely fun. However, controls can feel clunky and unresponsive, especially during intense matches. The animations are outdated, which hurts immersion compared to other football games.

Matchmaking is often slow, and connection issues like lag and disconnections are frustratingly common. The player base remains small, limiting the competitive scene and sometimes making it tough to find quality matches.

Despite these problems, I keep coming back because the game has potential and the developers seem to be working on improvements. If you’re patient and enjoy the basics of football games, there’s some fun here — but it’s far from perfect.
